castanea_sativa.Багрилни качества:
Mordant: visible colour without a metal mordant; iron for a dark grey-brown.
pH: neutral is a good starting point.
Temperature: hot extraction.
Cellulose: can serve as a tannin material, but it brings a beige-brown ground of its own.
castanea_sativa.Багрилна съставка: Chestnut parts are rich in hydrolysable tannins. These bind to cellulose and form complexes with metal ions, which gives both the tannin function and a brownish colour of its own.
castanea_sativa.Как се държи: Leaves, bark and green husks give sandy beige through warm and grey-brown. The material is strongly tannic and reacts distinctly with iron. The tannin bath itself colours, so it does not suit a preparation that has to stay neutral.
castanea_sativa.Беритба и обработка:
When to gather: leaves — sound and grown during the season; the green husks — once the nuts have formed, or as waste from the harvest; bark — only from prunings or cut branches.
What is used: leaves · bark · green husks.
Processing: use the leaves fresh or dry them; cut or crush husks and bark before extracting.
Storage: fully dry and dark; keep the parts separate.

lawsonia_inermis.Багрилни качества:
Mordant: not required for protein fibres; alum or tannin can help on cellulose.
pH: slightly acidic to neutral is a good start.
Temperature: a moderate hot bath.
Fastness: usually good, particularly on wool and silk.
lawsonia_inermis.Багрилна съставка: The main dye component is lawsone, a naphthoquinone that can bind directly to nucleophilic groups in the fibre, especially in proteins. This accounts for the good substantivity and the characteristic orange-brown.
lawsonia_inermis.Как се държи: The leaves give warm orange, rust and reddish brown. The colour develops as lawsone binds to the fibre and usually deepens after oxidation. It is more dependable on protein fibres; on cellulose the preparation matters.
lawsonia_inermis.Беритба и обработка:
When to gather: during the growing season, on a dry day; choose sound, fully grown leaves and tops. For flowering herbs, from the beginning of bloom to full bloom is the most practical window.
What is gathered: leaves.
Processing: use fresh or dry in the shade, in a thin layer with good air movement.
Storage: once fully dry — dark and dry, in a paper bag or a closed container.

achillea_millefolium.Багрилни качества:
Mordant: alum for yellow; iron minimally, if greenish or grey is wanted.
pH: neutral to slightly acidic.
Temperature: moderate hot extraction; a hard boil is not needed.
Eco print: the flowers and fine leaves can give a delicate texture.
achillea_millefolium.Багрилна съставка: The colour comes mainly from flavonoids and other phenolic compounds in the aerial parts. These form complexes with mordants, which is why the yellow shifts towards green-grey with iron.
achillea_millefolium.Как се държи: The flowering tops give soft yellows, straw and greenish tones. The plant suits gentle yellows and background texture better than a deep principal colour.
achillea_millefolium.Беритба и обработка:
When to gather: on a dry day, when the flowers or flower heads are fully out; for the most even material, choose sound, unwilted plants.
What is gathered: flowers · leaves · flowering tops.
Processing: use fresh, or spread in a thin layer and dry in the shade with good air movement.
Storage: once fully dry — dark and dry, in a paper bag or a closed container.

salvia_officinalis.Багрилни качества:
Mordant: alum for a lighter yellow; a little iron for greenish greys.
pH: neutral to slightly acidic.
Temperature: moderate hot extraction.
Eco print: the leaves can leave soft marks and silhouettes, but this is not a dependable strong tannin printer.
salvia_officinalis.Багрилна съставка: The leaves are rich in phenolic acids and flavonoids. These water-soluble phenolics give the muted yellow-brown tones; the essential oils are aromatic but are not the main textile colourant.
salvia_officinalis.Как се държи: The leaves give muted yellow, mustard and mossy green. The dye strength is moderate; the plant is more interesting as a local or garden material and for background texture.
salvia_officinalis.Беритба и обработка:
When to gather: during the growing season, on a dry day; choose sound, fully grown leaves and tops. For flowering herbs, from the beginning of bloom to full bloom is the most practical window.
What is gathered: leaves.
Processing: use fresh or dry in the shade, in a thin layer with good air movement.
Storage: once fully dry — dark and dry, in a paper bag or a closed container.

mentha_spp.Багрилни качества:
Mordant: alum for light yellow-greens; iron minimally.
pH: neutral to slightly acidic.
Temperature: moderate hot extraction.
Status: a garden or experimental dye, with softer fastness.
mentha_spp.Багрилна съставка: Mint contains flavonoids and phenolic acids, which extract into water and give yellow-greenish tones. Chlorophyll and the essential oils do not give a stable bright green on textile in an ordinary water bath.
mentha_spp.Как се държи: The leaves and tops give pale yellows, yellow-greens and grey-greens. The colour is soft and iron mutes it quickly. It is not a dependable source of bright green.
mentha_spp.Беритба и обработка:

What is gathered: leaves · flowering tops.
Processing: use fresh or dry in the shade, in a thin layer with good air movement.
Storage: once fully dry — dark and dry, in a paper bag or a closed container.

melissa_officinalis.Багрилни качества:
Mordant: alum for a light yellow; iron minimally.
pH: neutral to slightly acidic.
Temperature: moderate hot extraction.
Status: a local or experimental dye, not a classic strong colourant.
melissa_officinalis.Багрилна съставка: Lemon balm contains phenolic acids, rosmarinic acid among them, and flavonoids. Water extraction of these polyphenols gives the muted yellow-brown range; the essential oil is not a significant dye component.
melissa_officinalis.Как се държи: The leaves give pale yellows, beige-yellows and greenish browns. The colour is soft and fairly low in intensity; iron shifts it towards grey-green. It suits experimental garden baths and grounds better than a feature colour.
melissa_officinalis.Беритба и обработка:

What is gathered: leaves.
Processing: use fresh or dry in the shade, in a thin layer with good air movement.
Storage: once fully dry — dark and dry, in a paper bag or a closed container.

calendula_officinalis.Багрилни качества:
Mordant: alum for yellow-orange; iron sparingly.
pH: neutral to slightly acidic.
Temperature: moderate hot extraction.
Eco print: good for marks and texture, fresh flowers especially.
calendula_officinalis.Багрилна съставка: The flowers contain flavonoids and carotenoid pigments. In water dyeing the water-soluble phenolic and flavonoid fraction matters more; the carotenoids contribute to the flower's own colour but extract only partially into water.
calendula_officinalis.Как се държи: The flowers give buttery yellow, honey and yellow-orange. Fresh material usually gives the livelier result, but the dye strength is moderate.
calendula_officinalis.Беритба и обработка:
When to gather: on a dry day, when the flowers or flower heads are fully out; for the most even material, choose sound, unwilted plants.
What is gathered: flowers.
Processing: use fresh, or spread in a thin layer and dry in the shade with good air movement.
Storage: once fully dry — dark and dry, in a paper bag or a closed container.
